newsitem.title: USA: Molten Metal delays releasing 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Molten Metal delays releasing 1996 results.

text.p: Molten Metal Technology said on Tuesday it will dely reporting its 1996 financial results until mid-May, because of a delay in completing the audited statement for M4 Environmental LP, Molten's limited partnership with Lockheed Martin Corp.

Molten also said that both it and M4 Environmental are in the process of reassessing the value of certain of their respective fixed assets, as part of the audit process. Their financial statements cannot be completed until the reassessments are completed.

Molten said it and Lockheed previously had announced a planned restructuring of M4 Environmental under which assets related to M4's Retech division would be transferred to Lockheed, and Molten would become sole owner of M4.
Molten is an environmental technology company that transforms wastes into reusable industrial products.
